g.text: (d) The one violation, small and last
THE PREREGISTERED ESCALATION THIS FIGURE TRIPS
"programme_free >= programme_only on the held-out molecular channel; if programme_only wins, the collapse story is wrong -- escalate, do not proceed to D2"
programme_only won on all three seeds. This paper flags that
The arms differ in OBJECTIVE, so D1 sits closer to a between-
method comparison than D2 and lands further outside RankMe's
stated scope. Section 4.7 is therefore a CONFIRMATION of
RankMe, not a refutation of it, and this figure carries the
F6. This is the paper's own negative and it is reported before the instances that favour the paper. D1_PAIRED_BOOTSTRAP.json (unsuffixed) MUST NOT be used and is not vendored
here: it scores all 90 non-control targets, of which 50 are programme_only's own supervision. The intervals drawn are the 40-target STRATIFIED bootstrap and the 90-target
RANDOM_CONTROL bootstrap. Both estimators are drawn and the conservative one is weighted: the patient bootstrap is decisive 3 of 3, the cancer-cluster bootstrap 2 of 3, and seed
43's cancer interval grazes zero - the panel shows that it does. The arms are matched on everything but the objective (D1_PAIR_MANIFEST.json, "objective_only_difference": true).
Statistic R1, block confound-residualised, on the held-out wsi_biology block. PANEL (a)'S PREDECLARATION: the violation region is fold >= 2.0 AND dCCA >= +0.0705, both fixed
before the pair list was inspected. They are declared in v2/research/rebase/p2/p2_necessity_and_variance.py and quoted as pre-fixed in
NOTEBOOK_ENTRIES/p2_competing_metrics_and_necessity_test_20260803T2326Z.md; the four outcomes O1-O4 and how each would be read were pre-declared 2026-08-03 23:00 UTC in
NOTEBOOK_ENTRIES/PREDECLARED_D1_necessity_test_20260803T2300Z.md, before any channel value had been seen.
